centrality.betweenness_length: NetworkX betweenness_centrality with weight='length'; weight is path cost
centrality.closeness_length: NetworkX closeness_centrality with distance='length'; units are 1 / local unit
centrality.edge_betweenness: NetworkX edge_betweenness_centrality mapped deterministically to canonical edge_id

graph_representations.G_ox: MultiDiGraph with two reciprocal arcs per canonical physical street
graph_representations.G_physical: undirected MultiGraph with one edge per canonical physical street
graph_representations.G_simple: Graph created only after zero self-loop and zero parallel-edge assertions; node, edge, endpoint and canonical edge identities rechecked

networkx_functions_used.Graph.degree: G_physical MultiGraph; physical incidence and handshake theorem
networkx_functions_used.average_shortest_path_length: G_simple Graph; weight=None for hops and weight='length' for local-unit distance
networkx_functions_used.betweenness_centrality: G_simple Graph; weight=None and weight='length' as path cost
networkx_functions_used.bridges / articulation_points: G_simple Graph; topological vulnerability with canonical ID mapping
networkx_functions_used.degree_centrality: G_simple Graph; degree divided by n-1
networkx_functions_used.edge_betweenness_centrality: G_simple Graph; weight=None and weight='length', then canonical edge_id mapping
networkx_functions_used.node_connectivity / edge_connectivity: G_simple Graph; exact minimum disconnecting sets
networkx_functions_used.number_connected_components / is_connect: G_simple Graph; component identity and connected-only guard
networkx_functions_used.single_source_dijkstra_path_length: G_simple Graph; per-node mean distance with weight='length'

osmnx_functions_not_used.bearing.add_edge_bearings: forbidden: orientation belongs to Phase 7G and requires geographic assumptions
osmnx_functions_not_used.distance.add_edge_lengths: forbidden: would calculate great-circle distance on invented geographic coordinates
osmnx_functions_not_used.stats.basic_stats: not used because it bundles density and geometry semantics inappropriate for this local synthetic network
osmnx_functions_not_used.stats.edge_length_total: not used because OSMnx documents geographic/metric units while this network uses local units
osmnx_functions_not_used.stats.street_length_total: not used because Phase 7F defers geometric length summaries and this network uses local units

osmnx_functions_used.stats.count_streets_per_node: G_ox MultiDiGraph; physical street incidence per node
osmnx_functions_used.stats.intersection_count: G_ox MultiDiGraph; nodes with at least 2 streets
osmnx_functions_used.stats.street_segment_count: G_physical MultiGraph; 69 physical edges rather than 138 arcs
osmnx_functions_used.stats.streets_per_node: G_ox MultiDiGraph after explicit street_count population
